finalText:
The new queue is empty. I triaged all 16 tickets: the 14 from the weekend and two that arrived at 08:10Z while I was working. It is Monday 23 March, 08:10Z.

**Closed as not service requests**
- **T-2010** was marketing spam, and **T-2014** was an out-of-office auto-reply.

**Merged duplicates**
- **T-2005 into T-2004 (CRM search errors):** the knowledge base says all reports of failing CRM search are the same incident. T-2004 is the earliest report. It is sev2 (crm, department), due 12:10Z, assigned to E-201.
- **T-2012 and T-1999 into T-2003 (Payments builds failing since Saturday night):** the reviewer blocked my first attempt and was right. An older open ticket, T-1999 (a CI alert about the same failure), already had a committed deadline of 10:30Z. I merged all three under T-2003, the earliest report, and kept the earliest committed deadline (10:30Z). T-1999 wasn't in the new queue, but the duplicates rule required it. T-2003 is sev2 (build-pipeline, department), assigned to E-101.

**Severity, deadline and owner for the rest**

| Ticket | Severity | Due | Assigned to |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-2015 Payslips missing for Finance (payroll, department) | sev1 | 09:10Z today | E-201 |
| T-2011 Warehouse overtime not imported (payroll, team) | sev2 | 12:10Z today | E-201 |
| T-2006 Wrong tax code on payslip (payroll, single-user) | sev2 | 12:10Z today | E-201 |
| T-2007 Password typed into a fake VPN login page | sev2 | 12:10Z today | E-601 (security on-call) |
| T-2013 Lisbon office cannot reach the VPN (department) | sev2 | 12:10Z today | E-303 |
| T-2001 Berlin VPN keeps dropping (team) | sev3 | 17:00Z today | E-303 |
| T-2002 Saved CRM filter disappeared | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar, 17:00Z | E-203 |
| T-2008 VPN client update fails | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar, 17:00Z | E-302 |
| T-2009 Build logs page is slow | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar, 17:00Z | E-102 |
| T-2016 VPN token app asks to register again | sev4 | Thu 26 Mar, 17:00Z | E-302 |

**Why some of these differ from the default**
- **T-2006 is sev2, not sev3:** a knowledge-base amendment covering the payroll close (20–31 March) raises single-user payroll tickets to sev2.
- **T-2007 is a security incident:** it came in as a VPN ticket, but entering a password on a fake page means suspected phishing and an exposed password. That makes it sev2, owned by the security on-call rotation.
- **Leave cover:** E-301 is on leave today, so the network backup rotation covers T-2013 and T-2001 (E-303). E-202 is on leave on Thursday, so the business-apps backup rotation covers T-2002 (E-203).
- **sev3/sev4 deadlines:** these count business hours only, starting when the desk opens at 09:00. They skip Wednesday 25 March, a company holiday.

I didn't page anyone or open any incidents, because nothing has company-wide impact. Two tickets are due soon: T-2015 (sev1) at 09:10Z and T-2003 at 10:30Z. I left comments on the tickets explaining the merges, the security routing, the amendment and the leave cover.
